brief.objective: Get the Bandit within 5 m of the Lady while never letting the Guard within 5 m.
brief.approach: Default brief: approach directly, evade the Guard when it closes inside the keep-out radius.

goal.rationale: The Guard sits on the direct line between Bandit and Lady at about 600 m from the Lady, so routing via a radial offset to (-60, -400) skirts it while keeping closing speed moderate before the keep-out radius is threatened.

The Guard is closing on the Bandit at about 12.7 m/s from roughly 660 m off the Lady's line, so a wider radial offset to (-200, -400) keeps the crossing well outside the 150 m keep-out while the closing speed is trimmed to 10 m/s to save fuel.

The Guard is drifting down-track toward the Bandit's approach lane, so routing via a wider radial offset at (-300, -300) keeps the crossing well outside the 150 m keep-out while trimming closing speed to 8 m/s to conserve fuel.

The Guard sits near x=+42 m on the direct line to the Lady and is closing on the Bandit, so routing via the radial offset at (-300, -300) keeps the Bandit well clear of its 150 m keep-out while holding closing speed to 8 m/s to conserve fuel.

The Bandit is still about 1540 m from the Guard, and the Guard sits near x=0 on the direct line, so routing through the (-300,-300) offset keeps roughly 280 m of clearance while raising the closing speed to 10 m/s to make up the remaining 2330 m within the 200 s left.

The Guard is closing on the Bandit at about 12.5 m/s from the middle of the line, so this waypoint offsets the route about 250 m radially to keep clearance while raising closing speed to 12 m/s to cover the remaining 2230 m in the 190 s left.

The Guard sits near the Bandit-Lady line at about 850 m along-track, so routing the Bandit through a waypoint offset about 400 m radially to the negative-x side keeps the path roughly 290 m clear of the Guard while still closing at 12 m/s toward the Lady.
The Guard sits about 146 m off the direct Bandit-Lady line near y=-844, so the path through the negative-x waypoint keeps roughly 260 m clearance while the Bandit continues closing toward the Lady.

The Guard is actually about 20 m off the direct Bandit-Lady line at roughly y=-832 (not 146 m as previously stated), so the Bandit should swing toward positive x to pass it with clearance before resuming the approach to the Lady.

The Guard sits almost exactly on the Bandit-Lady line about 850 m from the Lady and closing on the Bandit, so the Bandit should swing toward positive x and keep at least about 240 m of lateral clearance from the Guard before resuming the approach.

The Guard sits almost exactly on the Bandit-Lady line about 820 m out and closing at about 12 m/s, so the Bandit should swing toward positive x with a waypoint farther off the line to keep well clear of the 150 m keep-out while staying on a path toward the Lady.

The Guard is nearly stationary about 890 m from the Lady on the Bandit-Lady line, so the Bandit should keep steering toward the offset waypoint at (300, -600) m, which stays roughly 265 m from the Guard's track and off the direct approach path, while limiting closing speed to 10 m/s.

The Bandit is closing on the Guard at about 12 m/s from 580 m, so keep the offset waypoint route (predicted to pass about 225 m from the Guard) at a reduced 8 m/s closing limit to avoid entering the 150 m keep-out.

The Guard is still about 460 m away and closing at 11 m/s, so I keep the offset route around its +x side at the reduced 8 m/s limit to hold clearance well outside the 150 m keep-out while the Lady remains the goal.

The Guard is about 344 m away and closing at 11.8 m/s from the bandit's line of approach, so I widen the offset route to the +x side (waypoint 400,-700) to keep roughly 290 m of clearance from its predicted path while still making progress toward the Lady.

The Guard is 224 m away and closing at 11.9 m/s almost along the Bandit's line to the Lady, so I route the Bandit to the +x side with EVADE_GUARD to keep it outside the 150 m keep-out while still making progress toward the Lady.

The Guard is 104 m away and inside the 150 m keep-out, sitting between the Bandit and the Lady, so I route the Bandit to the outer -x side with EVADE_GUARD at reduced closing speed to open the range before resuming the approach.
